title: Vigorous Upper Body
description: Push and pull in 3 sets: decline push-ups, chair dips and inverted rows for a solid upper body

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Fast march in place
exercises.instructions: March quickly in place, swinging your arms

exercises.name: Side shuffles
exercises.instructions: Fast lateral movements, 3-4 steps each side

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate rounding and arching your back, breathe

exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands shoulder-width apart, body braced, lower your chest to the floor

exercises.name: Decline push-ups
exercises.instructions: Feet elevated on a chair, body braced

exercises.name: Chair dips
exercises.instructions: Hands on the edge, elbows pointing back, lower to 90 degrees

exercises.name: Table inverted row
exercises.instructions: Under a table, pull your chest toward the edge

exercises.name: Alternating Superman
exercises.instructions: Lift right arm and left leg together, alternate sides

exercises.name: Prone T raises
exercises.instructions: Face down, arms in a T position, squeeze shoulder blades

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.instructions: Grab your foot behind you, knee toward the floor

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Hip 90/90
exercises.instructions: Seated, legs at 90 degrees, pivot from side to side

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
